proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D E hE hs hpar
  rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev] at hpar
  have m1 : D -ᵥ C ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {B -ᵥ A} := by rw [hpar]; exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp m1
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by
    by_contra hk0
    rcases (not_lt.mp hk0).lt_or_eq with hneg | hz
    · have hD : D = k • (B -ᵥ A) +ᵥ C := by rw [hk, vsub_vadd]
      have h3 := AffineSubspace.sOppSide_smul_vsub_vadd_left (s := line[ℝ, A, C]) hs.2.1
        (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C) (right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C) hneg
      rw [← hD] at h3
      exact hs.symm.not_sOppSide h3
    · rw [hz, zero_smul] at hk
      exact hs.2.2 (vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq.mp hk.symm ▸ right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C)
  have hpi := hE.angle₁₂₃_eq_pi
  unfold EuclideanGeometry.angle at hpi ⊢
  obtain ⟨-, r, hr, hrw⟩ := InnerProductGeometry.angle_eq_pi_iff.mp hpi
  have hAC : A -ᵥ C = (-r) • (E -ᵥ A) := by
    rw [neg_smul, ← hrw, neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev]
  rw [hAC, ← hk, InnerProductGeometry.angle_smul_left_of_pos _ _ (neg_pos.mpr hr),
    InnerProductGeometry.angle_smul_right_of_pos _ _ hkpos]
